invariants.rationale: The returned scroll amount, based on vertical measurements, should never be negative.
The method returns at most actorArea.height as determined by Math.min.
The result is the minimum of actorArea.height and a value that is at least (Math.max(actorArea.height * 0.9f, maxY * 0.1f) / 4).
Result is always set by this exact computation.
Since result is the minimum of actorArea.height and the other value, it must also be less than or equal to the latter.
